Morning, everyone. It's Dana. I know you're all waiting, so here are the names. The interschool squad is Kai, Harper, Jess and Renato. Our reserve is Tom. Well done, all of you, and thank you to everybody who surfed on Saturday. It was a really hard choice. Now, the important stuff. The kit arrives on Wednesday. Every surfer gets a hoodie, a yellow jersey and a sticker for the board. The hoodies all look the same, so write your name on the label the same day. The jerseys are not yours to keep. They're the club's, and they come back to me after every comp. First training is Thursday at six. Don't be late. See you there.

Hey mate, it's Kai. Quick question. Did you take a hoodie home from the van yesterday? Because I've got one here, and it isn't mine. Mine has a little hole in the sleeve, and this one doesn't. There's no name on the label, of course. I think it's yours, because it smells like your wax. Coconut, right? So I think you've got mine, and I've got yours. Can you bring it to training on Thursday? Oh, and Jess says the pink towel in the van is hers, not Harper's. Harper says it's hers. I'm staying out of that one. See you Thursday.
